# cloudsmith_policy_action (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_slug_perm` (String) The slug_perm of the policy this action belongs to.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace the policy belongs to.

### Optional

- `add_package_tags` (Block List, Max: 1) Add tags to matching packages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--add_package_tags))
- `precedence` (Number) The order in which this action occurs relative to other actions for the same policy.
- `remove_package_tags` (Block List, Max: 1) Remove tags from matching packages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--remove_package_tags))
- `set_package_state` (Block List, Max: 1) Set the state of matching packages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--set_package_state))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the action was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug_perm` (String) The action's unique permanent slug.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the action was last updated.

- `tags` (Set of String) The tags to add to matching packages.
